subject: [PATCH RFC nfs-utils v2 10/10] nfsdctl: check the netlink attribute puts in set_listeners()

2026-09-14.patch_summary: This patch fixes an issue in the nfsdctl utility where it silently truncates listener information when sending netlink messages to the kernel, leading to EINVAL errors. The fix checks for and reports overflows of listener information within a single message, preventing truncated data from being sent.
